name: Slab
description: Read and organize Slab (team wiki) from any AI agent via its GraphQL API: search posts, read a post, list topics and their posts, create a post. 6 tools, API token (Business and Enterprise plans).
instructions:
This connector uses the Slab GraphQL API (`https://api.slab.com/v1/graphql`). Schema reference: https://studio.apollographql.com/public/Slab/variant/current/schema/reference

**Setup**:
1. Slab's API is available on the **Business** and **Enterprise** plans only.
2. In Slab open **Team Settings → Developer** and copy the API token.
3. Set `SLAB_API_TOKEN`.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer ${SLAB_API_TOKEN}`.

**What the token can see**: the API acts as the *Slab Bot* user. A post or topic Slab Bot has no access to is missing from every result — if something you expect is not there, give Slab Bot access to it in Slab.

**Workflow**:
1. `slab_search_posts` to find posts by text (cursor-paginated: pass `pageInfo.endCursor` back as `after`), or `slab_list_topics` → `slab_get_topic_posts` to browse.
2. `slab_get_post` with a post ID for the full post.
3. `slab_create_post` to add a new, empty post, optionally inside a topic.

**Post content is Quill Delta JSON, not Markdown**: `content` is a list of `{ insert, attributes }` operations — the text is the concatenation of the `insert` strings, formatting sits in `attributes`. Writing content goes through `updatePostContent(id, delta)` with a Delta *change* (`retain` / `delete` / `insert`), which you can send with `slab_graphql_mutation`.

**Topics = folders**: posts live in topics, which can be nested (`parent`).

**Beyond the typed tools**: every GRAPHQL adapter gets `slab_graphql_query` / `slab_graphql_mutation` for any operation in the schema reference above (users, comments, `updatePost`, `addTopicToPost`, `syncPost` for mirroring an external Markdown document, …).

**Out of scope here**: integrations, billing, workspace export.

tools.name: slab_get_organization
tools.description: Return the Slab organization the token belongs to (id, name, host). A cheap call to check that the token works.

endpointMapping.path: query Organization { organization { id name host } }

tools.name: slab_get_post
tools.description: Fetch one post by ID: title, owner, topics, timestamps and its content as Quill Delta JSON (the text is the concatenation of the insert strings).

id.description: Post ID, from slab_search_posts or slab_get_topic_posts.

endpointMapping.path: query GetPost($id: ID!) { post(id: $id) { id title content insertedAt updatedAt publishedAt archivedAt linkAccess owner { id name } topics { id name } } }

tools.name: slab_search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search over the posts Slab Bot can see. Returns title, a highlighted snippet and the post's ID, owner and topics. Cursor-paginated: pass pageInfo.endCursor back as after.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor.

endpointMapping.path: query SearchPosts($query: String!, $first: Int = 20, $after: String) { search(query: $query, types: [POST], first: $first, after: $after) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } edges { node { ... on PostSearchResult { title highlight post { id title updatedAt publishedAt owner { name } topics { id name } } } } } } }

tools.name: slab_list_topics
tools.description: List every topic (folder) of the organization with its ID, name and parent topic. Slab returns the whole list at once, without paging.

endpointMapping.path: query ListTopics { organization { topics { id name parent { id name } } } }

tools.name: slab_get_topic_posts
tools.description: List the posts inside one topic (ID, title, timestamps). Slab returns them all at once, without paging.

endpointMapping.path: query TopicPosts($id: ID!) { topic(id: $id) { id name posts { id title updatedAt publishedAt archivedAt } } }

tools.name: slab_create_post
tools.description: Create a new, empty post with a title, optionally inside a topic. Slab creates posts blank: add content afterwards with updatePostContent (Quill Delta) via slab_graphql_mutation.

topicId.description: Topic to create the post in, from slab_list_topics.

endpointMapping.path: mutation CreatePost($title: String, $topicId: ID) { createPost(title: $title, topicId: $topicId) { id title insertedAt topics { id name } } }
